Namespace ExcelCommon

        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function GuessPositiveClass(explicitText As String, rowCount As Func(Of Integer),
                                                   text As Func(Of Integer, String), binary As Func(Of Integer, Boolean),
                                                   ByRef positiveLabel As String) As Boolean
            positiveLabel = Nothing
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(explicitText) Then
                positiveLabel = explicitText
                Return True
            End If
            Dim distinctTokens As New List(Of String)()
            Dim distinctNormalized As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim allBinary01 As Boolean = True
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount() - 1
                Dim token As String = text(i)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token) Then Continue For
                If Not binary(i) Then allBinary01 = False
                Dim normalized As String = UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)
                If Not distinctNormalized.Contains(normalized) Then
                    distinctNormalized.Add(normalized)
                    distinctTokens.Add(token)
                End If
            Next
            If allBinary01 Then
                positiveLabel = "1"
                Return True
            End If
            If distinctTokens.Count = 2 Then
                Dim norms As String() = distinctTokens.Select(Function(token) UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)).ToArray()
                For i As Integer = 0 To norms.Length - 1
                    Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(norms(i), {"positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"})
                        Case "positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"
                            positiveLabel = distinctTokens(i)
                            Return True
                    End Select
                Next
                positiveLabel = distinctTokens(0)
                Return True
            End If
            Return False
        End Function
    End Class

Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfModelImportPreparation38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub InitializeResponsePredictorsPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            yName As String, _
            predictorNames As String(), _
            yCol As Object(,), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            names(0) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(yName), "Y", yName)
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, 0) = yCol(i, 0)
            Next

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(j + 1) = predictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, j + 1) = xMat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub CopyNamedColumnPrepared(raw As Object(,), _
            names As String(), _
            rowCount As Integer, _
            nextCol As Integer, _
            columnName As String, _
            fallbackName As String, _
            column As Object(,))
            names(nextCol) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(columnName), fallbackName, columnName)
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, nextCol) = column(i, 0)
            Next
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub InitializePredictorsPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            expectedPredictorNames As String(), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(j) = expectedPredictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, j) = xMat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub InitializeCoxPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            timeName As String, _
            statusName As String, _
            strataName As String, _
            predictorNames As String(), _
            timeCol As Object(,), _
            statusCol As Object(,), _
            strataCol As Object(,), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            hasStrata As Boolean, _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            names(0) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeName), "Time", timeName)
            names(1) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(statusName), "Status", statusName)

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, 0) = timeCol(i, 0)
                raw(i, 1) = statusCol(i, 0)
            Next

            Dim firstPredictorCol As Integer = 2
            If hasStrata Then
                names(2) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strataName), "Strata", strataName)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, 2) = strataCol(i, 0)
                Next
                firstPredictorCol = 3
            End If

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(firstPredictorCol + j) = predictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, firstPredictorCol + j) = xMat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

        End Sub
        Public Shared Function CompleteCategoricalMatrixPrepared(arr As Object(,), ByRef varNames As Object, cols As Integer, assumeHeader As Boolean, startRow As Integer, rows As Integer, isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), toText As Func(Of Object, String), resolveNames As Func(Of Object, Integer, String, String(), String()), ByRef data(,) As String, ByRef resolvedNames() As String) As Boolean
            Dim inferred(cols - 1) As String
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                inferred(j) = "Variable " & (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                If assumeHeader AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(0, j)) Then
                    inferred(j) = toText(arr(0, j))
                End If
            Next
            resolvedNames = resolveNames(varNames, cols, "Variable ", inferred)

            ReDim data(rows - 1, cols - 1)
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    data(i, j) = toText(arr(startRow + i, j))
                Next
            Next

            Return True
        End Function

            Dim pos As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim neg As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim normalizedPositive As String = normalize(positiveLabel)

            For i As Integer = 0 To markerCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim x As Double
                If Not finiteDouble(markerCol(i, 0), x) Then Continue For

                Dim label As String = toText(statusCol(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Continue For

                Dim isPositive As Boolean = False
                Dim iv As Integer
                If normalizedPositive = "1" AndAlso status01(statusCol(i, 0), iv) Then
                    isPositive = (iv = 1)
                Else
                    isPositive = String.Equals(normalize(label), normalizedPositive, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                End If

                If isLowerDirection Then x = -x
                If isPositive Then
                    pos.Add(x)
                Else
                    neg.Add(x)
                End If
            Next

            If pos.Count < 1 OrElse neg.Count < 1 Then Return False
            rocInput = New Double()() {pos.ToArray(), neg.ToArray()}
            Return True
        End Function

            Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
            Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
            Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

            For i As Integer = 0 To timeCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim t As Double
                Dim s As Integer
                If Not finiteDouble(timeCol(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
                If t < 0.0R Then Return False
                If Not status01(statusCol(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

                Dim g As String = "ALL"
                If hasGroup Then
                    g = toText(groupCol(i, 0))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                End If

                tList.Add(t)
                sList.Add(s)
                gList.Add(g)
                stratList.Add("ALL")
            Next

            If tList.Count < 1 Then Return False

            Dim err As String = Nothing
            records = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
            Return records IsNot Nothing AndAlso records.Count > 0
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildFactorEigen(model As Multivariate.FactorAnalysis, ByRef includeHeader As Object, matrixTrace As Func(Of Double(,), Double), readHeader As Func(Of Object, Boolean, Boolean)) As Object(,)
            Dim initialEigen() As Double = model.InitialEigenvalues
            Dim unrotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.UnrotatedLoadings, model.UnrotatedLoadings)
            Dim rotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.PatternMatrix, model.StructureMatrix)
            Dim totalVar As Double = matrixTrace(model.WorkingMatrix)
            Dim initPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(initialEigen, totalVar)
            Dim initCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(initPct)
            Dim extrPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(unrotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim extrCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(extrPct)
            Dim rotPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(rotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim rotCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(rotPct)

            Dim rows As Integer = Math.Max(initialEigen.Length, model.NumberOfFactors)
            Dim hdr As Boolean = readHeader(includeHeader, True)
            Dim out(rows - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 9) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Factor"
                out(0, 1) = "Initial Eigenvalue"
                out(0, 2) = "Initial %"
                out(0, 3) = "Initial Cumulative %"
                out(0, 4) = "Extraction SS Loadings"
                out(0, 5) = "Extraction %"
                out(0, 6) = "Extraction Cumulative %"
                out(0, 7) = "Rotation SS Loadings"
                out(0, 8) = "Rotation %"
                out(0, 9) = "Rotation Cumulative %"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = i + 1
                If i < initialEigen.Length Then
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = initialEigen(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = initPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = initCum(i)
                End If
                If i < model.NumberOfFactors Then
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = unrotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = extrPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 6) = extrCum(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 7) = rotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 8) = rotPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 9) = rotCum(i)
                End If
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1

                out(0, k + 2) = "Extracted"

        Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out
        End Function

            Dim parts As New List(Of Object(,))()

            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                Dim values() As Double = groups(i)
                If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim bins As Object(,) = computeBins(values, resolvedRule)
                If bins Is Nothing OrElse bins.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim part(bins.GetLength(0), 2) As Object
                part(0, 0) = "Group"

                    part(r + 1, 1) = bins(r, 0)

                Next
                parts.Add(part)
            Next

            Return parts
        End Function

            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()

            If totalRows <= 1 Then
                Return noteTable("Kaplan-Meier", "No survival-curve rows were returned.")
            End If

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, 6) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            out(0, 1) = "PlotOrder"
            out(0, 2) = "Time"
            out(0, 3) = "Survival"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "AtRisk"

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim groupName As String = recs(0).strGroup
                Dim prevProb As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevLL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim plotOrder As Integer = 1

                out(row, 0) = groupName
                out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                out(row, 2) = 0.0R
                out(row, 3) = 1.0R
                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

                Try

        Public Shared Function FindWrappedDiscriminantTablePrepared(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), title As String, startsWith As Boolean, toText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Object(,)
            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing
        End Function

                If String.Equals(item.GroupLabel, requested, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    gs = item
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            Return gs
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayMcpTables(data()() As Double, names() As String, which As String, alphaValue As Double, ByRef stackAll As Boolean) As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable)
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            stackAll = False
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(which, New String() {"", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK", "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES", "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD", "BONF", "BONFERRONI", "ALL", "BOTH"})
                Case "", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK"
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                Case "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES"
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                Case "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                Case "BONF", "BONFERRONI"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                Case "ALL", "BOTH"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                    stackAll = True
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
            Return mdl.wrapResults()

        Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out
        End Function

            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count
            Next

            If totalRows <= 1 Then
                Return noteTable("Kaplan-Meier", "No survival-curve rows were returned.")
            End If

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, 6) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            out(0, 1) = "PlotOrder"
            out(0, 2) = "Time"
            out(0, 3) = "Survival"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"

            Dim row As Integer = 1

                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim groupName As String = recs(0).strGroup
                Dim prevProb As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevLL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim plotOrder As Integer = 1

                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out

        Public Shared Function BuildRosnerTable(alpha As Double, outliers() As Double, addCaution As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim nOut As Integer = If(outliers Is Nothing, 0, outliers.Length)

            body(0, 1) = alpha
            body(1, 0) = "Number of outliers"
            body(1, 1) = nOut

            Dim n As Integer = model.GroupStatistics.Count

            out(0, 1) = "Count"
            out(0, 2) = "Prior"
            out(0, 3) = "Prior %"
            out(0, 4) = "LogDet (Working)"

            If model Is Nothing OrElse model.GroupStatistics Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim g As Integer = model.GroupStatistics.Count
            If g < 1 Then Return Nothing
            Dim p As Integer = model.GroupStatistics(0).MeanOriginal.Length
            Dim out(g, p) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = model.PreparedData.VariableNames(j)
            Next
            For i As Integer = 0 To g - 1

                Dim values() As Double = If(useOriginalScale, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanOriginal, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanWorking)
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = values(j)
                Next
            Next

        Public Shared Function FindWrappedDiscriminantTablePrepared(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), title As String, startsWith As Boolean, toText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Object(,)
            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FindDiscriminantGroupPrepared(statistics As IEnumerable(Of Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics), requested As String) As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics
            Dim gs As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics = Nothing
            For Each item As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics In statistics
                If String.Equals(item.GroupLabel, requested, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    gs = item
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            Return gs
        End Function

Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available
        End Function

            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing

        Public Shared Function BuildWelchAnovaTable(data()() As Double, names() As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            Dim w = mdl.WelshANOVA()

            Dim body(0, 3) As Object
            body(0, 0) = data.Length - 1
            body(0, 1) = w.DF1
            body(0, 2) = w.TestStatistics1
            body(0, 3) = w.Pvalue

            Dim t As New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            t.SetBody(body)
            t.AddPvalueToFormat(4)
            t.AddHeaderLeftRow({"Welch ANOVA"})
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Source", "df numerator", "df denominator", "F", "P-value"})
            Return t
        End Function

        ' Invalid selectors are resolved only AFTER construction/compute, as originally.
        ' wrapResults always supplies a non-null List in the pinned Core engine.
        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayMcpTables(data()() As Double, names() As String, which As String, alphaValue As Double, ByRef stackAll As Boolean) As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable)
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            stackAll = False
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(which, New String() {"", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK", "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES", "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD", "BONF", "BONFERRONI", "ALL", "BOTH"})
                Case "", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK"
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                Case "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES"
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                Case "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                Case "BONF", "BONFERRONI"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                Case "ALL", "BOTH"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                    stackAll = True
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
            Return mdl.wrapResults()
        End Function
